"''Let him in.|Jerus Jannick and Rabé|audio=TheBoysHere-TPM.flac|}} '''Jerus Jannick'''{{ThisWeek|DpATvwrcrUw|The Mandalorian Character Posters, Life Day Celebrations with LEGO, and More!|sw_url=video/the-mandalorian-character-posters-life-day-celebrations-with-lego-and-more}} was a [[human]] [[Naboo Palace Guard|Palace Guard]]{{Databank|naboo-royal-guards|Naboo Royal Guards}} of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]], which served the [[Royal House of Naboo|Royal House]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. Carrying an [[S-5 Security-grade blaster/ascension gun|S-5 blaster pistol]] and a [[comlink]], they wore a [[helmet]] with [[armor]] plating polished in a Naboo aesthetic, [[leather]] neck covering, and an adjustable chin strap.{{HelmetCollectionCite|54|Helmets}} states that [[Naboo Palace Guard|Palace Guards]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] wore [[armor]] with [[Naboo]]-style polished plating, a [[helmet]] with a [[leather]] neck covering and adjustable chin strap, [[boot]]s with high-traction soles, and a [[Clothing|uniform]] with a top coat and designed to absorb energy blasts. Since {{Film|I}} depicts Jerus Jannick as a member of the force, this article assumes their armor shares these characteristics. Jannick also donned a [[Clothing|uniform]] armored with a top coat and designed to absorb energy blasts while giving its wearer freedom of movement. The uniform featured a [[utility belt]] with pouches for ammunition and a communicator, and Jannick wore [[boot]]s with high-traction soles designed to allow for moving silently. In [[32 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]]. the human [[Gender|boy]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] visited the chambers of [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] on the planet [[Coruscant]], at the entrance of which Jannick was standing [[Security guard|guard]]. When Skywalker arrived, Jannick used their comlink to inform the [[handmaiden]] [[Rabé Tonsort|Rabé]] that Skywalker was there in search of Padmé. Skywalker went in, only to be informed by Rabé that Padmé was unavailable. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|I wanted to meet George Lucas, and I said, 'Please, can you give me any part at all?' And they said, 'Well, we've got Naboo Officer or we've got Palace Guard.' So I took both.|Dominic West|{{WebCite|url=https://tv.avclub.com/dominic-west-on-the-hour-john-carter-and-yes-the-wir-1798234909|text=Dominic West on ''The Hour'', ''John Carter'', and yes, ''The Wire''|author=Harris, Will|date=2012-11-26|work=[https://www.avclub.com The A.V. Club]|archivedate=20210201184552}}}} [[File:JerusJannick-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|225px|Jerus Jannick in the costume worn in the deleted scene]] Jerus Jannick first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], where they were portrayed by actor [[Dominic West]]. On [[October 15]], [[2020]], the character was identified in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in an installment of ''[[This Week! in Star Wars]]'', a weekly video series released on the official ''Star Wars'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel. West revealed in an interview that he had wanted to meet ''Star Wars'' creator [[George Lucas]], whom he considered a very influential figure in his childhood.{{WebCite|url=http://legacy.aintitcool.com/node/54077|text=Capone talks ''JOHN CARTER'', ''THE PHANTOM MENACE'', ''The Wire'', and more with Dominic West!!!|author=Capone|date=2012-03-06|work=[https://www.aintitcool.com Ain't It Cool News]|archivedate=20210201185253}} When he asked for a part, he was told that he could either play a Palace Guard or a Naboo Officer, both of which he accepted. The name [[Jerus Jannick/Legends|Jerus Jannick]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was used in the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game's]] [[2001]] ''[[Theed Palace Limited]]'' expansion on a card of the same name. The card uses a promotional image of Dominic West in his Naboo Officer uniform,{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Jerus Jannick}} which he wore in a scene from ''The Phantom Menace'' that was ultimately deleted. In the scene, [[Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka|Panaka]] contacts Jannick, who is standing by a [[B1-series battle droid]] following the [[Battle of Naboo]]. Jannick then tips the [[droid]] over, showing Panaka that it had been disabled.{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Complete Saga|scene=The Battle is Over}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'' *{{ThisWeek|DpATvwrcrUw|The Mandalorian Character Posters, Life Day Celebrations with LEGO, and More!|sw_url=video/the-mandalorian-character-posters-life-day-celebrations-with-lego-and-more}} {{1stID|Jerus Jannick}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Coruscant}} {{Po}} *[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Jannick, Jerus}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Naboo Palace Guards]]
